title: Chair Model
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, characters navigate parking disputes, discuss romantic interests, and reflect on past relationships. Michael seeks a new romantic connection, while conflicts over parking spaces escalate. The episode features Michael's attempts to meet someone special, including setting up a date through Pam, and reflects on past relationships, notably Michael’s breakup with Jan. The episode also includes humorous misunderstandings and character interactions centered around personal and professional life.
